solutionSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM shipments;
notes: AVG skips NULL weights, so one aggregate row is the whole answer. The numeric result carries a trailing zero (1032.0) because ROUND to one place keeps the scale.
